Fine FPS leaves exclude physical contact donors belonging to other leaves. A sparse physical-contact feature exchange across leaves can create a distinct point-feature information path absent from same-leaf FLE, without query/language routing.

Replacing only the middle-scale independent token FFN with fixed geometric directional convolution can exchange spatial context among 64 middle tokens before original HCG readback, improving referential localization. Efficacy unknown until native training.

Coarse scene tokens can define context-dependent channel relationships while each fine token retains its own spatially local values. A coarse-derived grouped channel operator may improve fine semantic interpretation before original HCG readback; efficacy unknown until native training.

Passing refined fine tokens through the original fixed-child mean before the original middle FFN, and refined middle tokens before the original coarse FFN, may compose nonlinear local evidence across hierarchy levels before the unchanged single HCG/inst_feats readback. This changes information dependence, not pooling weights or hyperparameters; task efficacy is unknown.

Original fine/middle membership edges jointly transform child and parent before private true-child equal means. Split upward evidence and retained branches; original coarse FFN composes upward messages, then middle/fine nonlinear synthesis carries context downward before original HCG and the single inst_feats writeback. Whole-graph role separation may improve native mask features; efficacy unknown.

A fixed same-original-parent geometric MST can instead generate a signed nonlinear contrast at each real edge and deliver equal/opposite updates to its endpoints before original HCG. This may alter local boundary/detail evidence in the actual inst_feats mask path; whether such a deficit or gain exists is UNKNOWN.

Identity-core real-arithmetic inversion is only a software property; task efficacy, novelty and whole-model invertibility UNKNOWN.

Distinct within-leaf feature dispersion and between-child semantic dispersion may provide useful scale responsibilities before the existing single inst_feats update. Preserve native point detail as second central moments, then propagate and separate within/between contributions along unchanged true memberships.

It adds native spatial association information absent from token means and diagonal feature variance; usefulness, population bottleneck and novelty remain UNKNOWN.
